stem.text: Which statement explains why it is necessary to use an electron microscope to see the cristae of a mitochondrion?

A.text: The magnification of the electron microscope is greater than that of the light microscope.

B.text: The membranes of the cristae are separated by a distance greater than $200\,\text{nm}$.

C.text: The resolution of a student microscope using daylight is too low.

D.text: The wavelength of an electron beam is longer than the wavelength of light.
